create_anomaly_postprocess_handler: create an AnomalyPostProcessHandler to analyze anomaly alerts from time series detection results
get_anomaly_intervals: get detected anomaly intervals as a list of IntervalAnomaly objects from the handler
get_severity_score_df: get a DataFrame with per-alert severity scores including volume, magnitude, and average height
get_overall_severity_score: get an overall severity summary DataFrame with total alerts, volume, duration, and magnitude
get_each_anomaly_type: get a DataFrame classifying each anomaly interval into level shift, individual, trend, or volatility change
